notes: Run tick-frozen with a connected creative headless client in an isolated arena. Each one-tick window resets the Wither position and velocity, then tests the side-head launch ring at Y82.2, radius1.3. Skulls are removed after every observation, before they can reach the sheep. The bounded20-tick window permits initial side-head acquisition/shot; scoreboard requires a real matching skull. Supplement with spawn-packet verification of both side heads and main head, using pre-travel Wither position; rendered-client appearance and full fight parity are unproven.
